title: Emergency Staffing Increase for Bottom 5% Performing Stores
description: Immediately hire and deploy additional staff to increase headcount by 25-30% in the 5 lowest performing stores. Fast-track hiring process through temporary staffing agencies if needed. Prioritize experienced retail workers who can start immediately.
expectedOutcome: All 5 bottom-performing stores have increased staff levels by at least 25% with trained personnel ready to handle order volume

title: Istanbul Region Operational Audit
description: Conduct comprehensive operational assessment of all Istanbul stores including: delivery route analysis, competitor mapping, local traffic pattern impact, customer complaint analysis, and staff interview sessions to identify region-specific challenges.
expectedOutcome: Detailed report identifying top 3 operational bottlenecks in Istanbul with actionable solutions for each

title: Implement Temporary Staff Redistribution Plan
description: Identify high-performing stores with excess capacity and temporarily reassign 1-2 staff members to support understaffed locations. Arrange transportation and temporary accommodation if needed. Focus on stores within same district first.
expectedOutcome: At least 15 staff members redistributed to critical stores, reducing immediate pressure on overwhelmed teams

title: Deploy Real-Time Store Monitoring Dashboard
description: Set up automated monitoring system tracking store uptime, POS system status, order processing times, and staff clock-in data. Configure alerts for any store offline >15 minutes or processing delays >20% above average.
expectedOutcome: Live dashboard accessible to all managers with automated alerts reducing response time to technical issues by 70%

title: Establish Istanbul Delivery Partnership Program
description: Negotiate partnerships with 2-3 local delivery services to supplement in-house delivery capacity during peak hours. Focus on services familiar with Istanbul traffic patterns and local area knowledge.
expectedOutcome: Signed agreements with delivery partners providing 30% additional delivery capacity during peak hours

title: Create Staffing Level Optimization Model
description: Develop data-driven staffing model based on order volume patterns, peak hours, and store size. Include buffer capacity for unexpected volume spikes. Create hiring triggers when stores approach 85% capacity utilization.
expectedOutcome: Automated staffing recommendation system preventing future understaffing situations with 2-week advance warning
